fighters_506: Strongest in the field. Forked from f995_701 with order pay and drills. It gained combat but follows orders only a little.
f995_701: The long-horizon fighter, the champion before this list. Fights hard and ignores orders.
f995_400: The same training run as f995_701, 301 updates earlier. Beats it in convoy escort.
f99_696: A sibling of f995_701 with a shorter horizon. Weakest of the top four overall, best of them in convoy escort.
followers_513: The only pilot that both fights well and follows orders. Forked from transit_300.
hide_644: Trained so that a shot under an order earned only order pay. It did not learn to follow, and it fires far less than the top five.
reward_300: Paid for following orders, with no script pull. It barely learned to follow.
transit_300: Pulled toward the script on the way to an order. The best neural follower, and a weak fighter.
w1_400: An early order pilot with the older, smaller order inputs. reward_300 and transit_300 both descend from it.
v1: The first fleet pilot: a clone of the script, sharpened by PPO. It predates orders and cannot read them.
